component.name: CloakScan
component.summary: Sanitize sensitive text before sharing it

description.p: CloakScan scans text locally for secrets, personal data, infrastructure details, and work-specific terms before the text is shared.
Scanning runs on this device. CloakScan has no account, backend, telemetry, or content upload.

screenshot.caption: Review detected values and the cleaned text before sharing.
Choose which local detection rules are enabled.

description.p: Leaves ordinary password-policy text and variable-only curl credentials unchanged while continuing to redact literal values.
Reports the actual scan duration instead of the React state-update time.
Redacts complete YAML credential blocks and common command, SDK, connection-string, provider-token, username, and support-text credential forms found during the final public-share campaign.
Leaves common documentation placeholders alone and keeps adjacent credential fields separate so neither surrounding syntax nor a second secret is lost.
Adds a short, collapsible update summary using release notes already returned by the manual desktop update check. Empty or unusable notes are omitted, and no extra network request is made.
Detects literal passwords containing dollar signs and punctuation, redacts complete GitHub token runs, and leaves exact empty structural placeholders such as xargs replacement tokens alone.
Fixes underscore-boundary misses for AWS, Stripe, OpenAI, npm, Databricks, and Hugging Face tokens while preserving harmless text around the detected token.

Detects credential fields that carry a trailing qualifier, such as PASSWORD_OLD or API_KEY_V2, and field names where the credential word is not last, such as aws_secret_access_key. Reads a dollar sign in a value per format instead of always treating it as a variable.
Stops leaving part of a credential behind when matches overlap, keeps surrounding code valid, and no longer redacts code that reads a secret from somewhere else. Large pastes scan far faster.
Fixes basic password, API-key, token, and secret fields that use unquoted values in common configuration and command formats. Executable variables and generated expressions remain untouched.

Completes the portfolio workflow: save a seeded Cloak List and rescan in one step, compare the two sanitized output modes side by side without rescanning, and export a three-file portfolio kit (sanitized script, aggregate-only findings summary, and a manual review checklist). Clear session now covers all of it.

Correction release: the readiness summary now counts every finding kept as-is (any severity), suggestions stop mislabeling person-like terms as organizations, common field labels stay out of likely terms, and public screenshots and media show current CloakScan.

Adds the Portfolio Review Workspace: Cloak List replacement strategies, smart mapping suggestions, a Build Portfolio Cloak List flow, a sanitization readiness summary, a script header metadata review lead, and output mode as a first-class setting.

Adds a Portfolio-code output mode that keeps sanitized PowerShell valid, reusable Cloak Lists with JSON import and export, IT automation review leads, an invalid-code warning panel, and wider test and build validation.
